subject: Application: Graduate Engineer - Roads and Highways, Sunshine Coast, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I am applying for the Graduate Engineer, Roads and Highways role on the Sunshine Coast through your LiveHire listing (job YMY8M), part of the Calibre Graduate Program.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project in charge and field engineer.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for site, office and regional work and open to discussing relocation for the right graduate role. I do not yet have Australian consulting employment.

Your two-year graduate pathway in Transport on Roads and Highways matches the road and civil documentation work I studied.

I have attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

letter.subject: Application: Graduate Engineer - Roads and Highways (YMY8M)
paragraphs: I am applying for the Graduate Engineer, Roads and Highways role with Calibre on the Sunshine Coast (LiveHire job YMY8M), as part of your two-year Graduate Program.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language: road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage design and documentation in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, with Australian Standards and Austroads guides, Before You Dig Australia enquiries, cost estimates, bills of quantities and risk registers. In 2019 I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, reviewed drawings, and carried out inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials and prepared site, material and progress reports.

I have no Australian consulting employment yet. I am based in Melton, Victoria, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for site, office and regional work and open to discussing relocation for this Sunshine Coast graduate role.
My resume and academic transcript materials are ready for the LiveHire form. Drawings and a longer profile are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.
